definitions.short: Elim , a place in the Desert
definitions.full: H362. Elim [ אֵילִים ], always אֵילִם proper name, of a location (= place of terebinths or other great trees, see Di Gen 14:6 & Exod 15:27 (12 fountains & 70 palms)) 2nd station of Israel in desert after passing sea 16:1 (twice in verse); Num 33:9-10 , אֵי֫לִמָה Exod 15:27 ; Num 33:9 ; probably = Wady Gharandel compare Rob BR i. 100, 105 .

occurrences.englishText: They came to Elim, where there were twelve springs of water, and seventy palm trees. They encamped there by the waters.

They took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came to the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.
